players.product: bottom anti-reflective coatings (ARC) for KrF and ArF lithography, multi-layer process materials (spin-on carbon, silicon hard mask), EUV materials and 3D packaging process materials

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: Nissan Chemical established Nissan Chemical Semiconductor materials Zhangjiagang Co., Ltd. (Zhangjiagang, Jiangsu, China; 100% owned; registered capital RMB 210 million, approximately JPY 5.0 billion; registered September 1, 2026) to manufacture and sell anti-reflective coatings (BARC) for photoresists and multilayer materials, strengthening its supply framework closer to customers in the growing Chinese semiconductor market; the first capital contribution of RMB 89 million (approximately JPY 2.1 billion) is scheduled for October 15, 2026; impact on FY3/2027 results expected to be immaterial.
